name: Zombie Garden: A Plant Defense Game
summary:
Your garden is under attack.

In Zombie Garden: A Plant Defense Game, you step inside the battlefield in fully immersive VR. Plant, grow, and strategically position powerful botanical defenders to stop relentless zombie waves from overrunning your backyard.

This isn’t just tower defense — you’re there.

🌱 Grow Your Defense
Cultivate unique combat plants with special abilities — rapid shooters, explosive bloomers, shield vines, and more.
